description: Highway Quality in Colorado is a series of datasets listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Highway segments and the various quality assurance data along with the overall grade, from the 2023 review of the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT). Coverage: Colorado. The portal lists 8 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are roads, highways, grade, conditions, concrete. The table has 29 columns. Attribution on the portal: CDOT. The portal shows 2024-06-17 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
